{{Quote|It's Minister Lorman! ''Minister'' Lorman! Is that so hard to remember?|Minister Gelmid Lorman|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>}}
'''Gelmid Lorman''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Lorman was not known for his skill or talent, so he used his family's connections to eventually earn him the rank of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. In [[3640 BBY]], Lorman served as the deputy [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'' and the non-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] right hand of the [[Dark Council]] Member, [[Darth Karrid]]. During the [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|Battle of Duro]], when all seemed lost, he ordered the evacuation of the ship. He was officially blamed for the ship's loss, but during the Eternal Empire's Conquest, his career was renewed and he had risen to become [[Minister of Logistics]] under Empress [[Darth Acina]]. Lorman took great pride in his title, and would loudly correct anyone who referred to him without it.

[[File:Gelmid_Lorman_and_Theron_Shan.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Lorman welcomes Acina's quests to Dromund Kaas.]]
During his career, [[Malavai Quinn]] defied his orders to cease his search for the missing [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], so Lorman had him thrown into prison for his defiance. When the Outlander came to Dromund Kaas by Acina's invitation to discuss an alliance, Lorman secretly [[Ambush on Dromund Kaas|plotted]] with the former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] to assassinate both the Empress and the Outlander as part of her coup to take over the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]], with promises that he would become the new Sith Emperor. After his plot was failed and deception revealed, Acina allowed the Outlander to decide his fate.
